introduction: Cortés is a teenager who experiences an unplanned pregnancy. Together with her boyfriend Miguel and her best friend Vegas, she has planned to fake her own kidnapping. The dream is to get money to go and live the American dream. For them it is the ultimate scam. Love and friendship dissolve under the pressure of the moment, dreams are destroyed, personalities change and each one will face a moment that will change the course of their lives forever.源自：https://programa.giff.mx/eng/2023/pelicula/2107
